description: Rules for order cancellation and returns in the customer support workspace.

demo_scenarios.name: Cancel a recently placed order
demo_scenarios.explanation: A pending, confirmed, or processing order can be cancelled within 24 hours when it has no shipping activity.

demo_scenarios.name: Cancel after the deadline
demo_scenarios.explanation: Cancellation is rejected after 24 hours from purchase or once shipping has started.

demo_scenarios.name: Return a delivered item
demo_scenarios.explanation: A fully delivered order can be returned within 30 days of delivery, subject to item quantity checks.

demo_scenarios.name: Return an order still in transit
demo_scenarios.explanation: Returns require every shipment to be delivered and to have a valid delivery timestamp.
